description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Badulla District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Badulla Administrative District. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, provides the original election date (09.03.2023), states the reason for postponement, and announces the new election date (25.04.2023). The content includes a schedule of specific local authorities affected. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, scheduling changes, and election administration.
